content: Telestream Vidchecker (descendant of Cerify) performs file-based automated QC: video spec checks, luma/chroma levels, bars & tones, macroblocking, PSE flash detection, RGB gamut, black/frozen frames, corrupt frames, letterbox/pillarbox detection, MXF structure, DPP metadata; offers automatic correction (mutates the file) as an add-on. DPP-certified for UK broadcast delivery compliance.
